dual_discovery.convention: z = first m inequality marginals minus second m; lambda is the sum-to-one equality marginal

scope: Finite binary64 LP over 123 canonical legal 42-site path columns and 1,779 normalized rows (1,461 low, 311 sixth, seven selected eighth). The ten added columns each have strictly positive 128-bit Arb reduced-cost intervals against the pinned 113-column dual. This LP does not certify its exact candidate, complete moment maxima, other physical generators, or an operational Choi/diamond-norm inversion bound.
